name: application-live-counter-tile
title: Live Counter Tile
description: Animated ticking number tile components for displaying realtime metrics like active sessions or live viewers.
useWhen: Animated ticking number tile components for displaying realtime metrics like active sessions or live viewers.
avoidWhen: Avoid live counter tile when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Live Counter Tile uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
